reason: A is the better of two weak proposals because it specifies a genuinely single intervention and a more exhaust-relevant activity-retention test, whereas B bundles NH3 annealing with acid etching and invokes electrochemical overpotential for thermal exhaust catalysis. Both largely transplant an already demonstrated fuel-cell HEA design and inadequately establish that nitrogen or an anneal-induced Pt-rich shell will persist under oxidizing hydrothermal aging, so A’s advantage is limited.
